statusDetail: Atomic coverage complete across the single search landing template, primary redirect flow, and representative 404 recovery path.

page.framework: Hand-authored HTML/CSS/JavaScript with Bootstrap and Taboola
page.notes: Public single-view search gateway. No additional first-party content routes exist: four footer labels are # links and sitemap.xml is absent. Search redirects to an external Yahoo results page.

paths.description: Homepage/search landing: the only first-party page template; audited at desktop, mobile portrait, 360x500 short-mobile, dark, forced-colors, reduced-motion, no-JS, performance, network, security and memory conditions.
Primary search journey using q=modern web, representing end-to-end redirect to the configured external provider.
Representative invalid first-party route, selected to test HTTP error and recovery behavior.

findings.summary: Dark preference does not produce a dark theme
findings.evidence: Dark screenshot remains white and visually matches the light screenshot.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and use prefers-color-scheme or light-dark() for every surface and control.

findings.summary: Search navigation swaps documents abruptly
findings.evidence: The tested query jumps directly from the landing page to an external Yahoo results document; no view-transition CSS exists.
findings.suggestedFix: Where same-origin navigation is available, add cross-document View Transitions with a reduced-motion fallback; preserve a stable search-shell cue across the redirect.

findings.summary: Footer navigation promises destinations but goes nowhere
findings.evidence: How Search works, Terms, FAQs and About all resolve to #.
findings.suggestedFix: Link each label to a real, unique URL and provide current-location/state cues.

findings.summary: Advertising recommendations overwhelm a minimal search task
findings.evidence: Rendered DOM evidence contains dozens of recommendation headlines and Lighthouse measured a 2,852px mobile body.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the recommendation feed from the task page, or defer it behind a clearly labelled, user-requested disclosure below results.

findings.summary: Short mobile viewports force a 500px desktop layout
findings.evidence: Layout at 360x500 reports 140px horizontal overflow due to fixed 500px widths in the max-height media query.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace fixed 500px widths with min(500px, 90vw) or intrinsic sizing and test narrow landscape/reflow conditions.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is invisible and targets are undersized
findings.evidence: Focused input computes no outline, border, or shadow; footer links are around 35.5px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Use :focus-visible with a high-contrast outline and make interactive targets at least 44×44 CSS px or provide equivalent spacing.

findings.summary: The 404 state strands users in storage-provider diagnostics
findings.evidence: Unknown route shows “Is this your bucket?” and only links to Cloudflare R2 documentation.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a branded 404 with a search field, Home link, concise explanation and retry/back recovery.

findings.summary: Mobile load is too slow and variable
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 8.3s LCP, 8.4s TTI and performance 69.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove/defer advertising code, prioritize the actual LCP asset, and retest LCP/INP/CLS under mobile throttling.

findings.summary: Render-blocking and cache policy delay the small page
findings.evidence: Bootstrap/local CSS and a non-deferred head script block parsing; Lighthouse estimated 1,040ms render-blocking savings and 93KiB cache savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline critical CSS, remove Bootstrap, defer the local script, and give versioned static assets long immutable cache lifetimes.

findings.summary: Most shipped framework and ad code is unused
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 172KiB unused Taboola JS and 38KiB unused CSS, including 97% of Bootstrap.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove Bootstrap for the small bespoke layout and load recommendation code only after explicit user demand.

findings.summary: Core search UI lacks accessible names and semantics
findings.evidence: Search input has no label, logo has no alt, and the document has no main landmark.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap core content in main, add a visible or visually hidden Search label, and give the logo meaningful alt text or mark it decorative.

findings.summary: Advertising attribution text fails contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured repeated 11px #999-on-white branding at 2.84:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Use text/background colors meeting at least 4.5:1 and avoid relying on tiny, faint attribution.

findings.summary: Page structure and focus indication are missing
findings.evidence: There are no headings or main landmark, and the focused input has no visible focus styling.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a logical h1/main structure and a persistent :focus-visible indicator that follows DOM reading order.

findings.summary: Reflow and target sizing fail on a common narrow condition
findings.evidence: 360x500 produces 140px overflow and several links are under 44px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Use fluid/intrinsic widths and enlarge or space targets so 320px/reflow layouts work without two-dimensional scrolling.

findings.summary: Logo asset is unsized and grossly oversized
findings.evidence: 1692px logo renders at 65px with no width/height attributes; image audit found seven unsized elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Export an appropriately sized AVIF/WebP/PNG and include explicit width and height attributes.

findings.summary: Markup and CSS contain avoidable structural defects
findings.evidence: Duplicate lucky_button IDs and an invalid unitless max-width query are present; Lighthouse reports inspector issues.
findings.suggestedFix: Use unique IDs, fix the media query to include px, validate HTML/CSS, and remove legacy payload.

findings.summary: Search result snippet metadata is weak
findings.evidence: Title is generic “Search” and meta description is absent in raw and rendered HTML.
findings.suggestedFix: Write a unique product/site title and concise meta description explaining what this search page provides.

findings.summary: Prominent informational links are not crawlable destinations
findings.evidence: Four footer links point only to #.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish real Terms, About, FAQ and How Search Works URLs with descriptive anchor text.

findings.summary: Canonical and sitemap signals are absent
findings.evidence: No canonical link exists and sitemap.xml returns 404 although robots allows indexing.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a self-referencing canonical and a valid sitemap referenced from robots.txt.

findings.summary: Share and entity metadata is absent
findings.evidence: No Open Graph tags or JSON-LD blocks are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Open Graph/Twitter preview data and WebSite/Organization JSON-LD matching visible content.

findings.summary: Foundational security headers are missing
findings.evidence: CSP, HSTS and X-Content-Type-Options are absent despite HTTPS delivery.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP, HSTS and nosniff after report-only testing; secure all future cookies.

findings.summary: Tracking footprint is disproportionate to the search task
findings.evidence: Ten third-party origins, eight known tracker hosts, 35 third-party requests and 411KB load by default.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove nonessential trackers, gate recommendations behind consent/demand, minimize event fields, batch necessary analytics, and document retention/purpose.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defenses are absent
findings.evidence: No frame protection, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy was returned.
findings.suggestedFix: Add frame-ancestors (or X-Frame-Options fallback), strict-origin-when-cross-origin or stricter Referrer-Policy, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Suggestion overlay positioning is brittle
findings.evidence: Suggestion box uses absolute positioning with unitless top/bottom values and the same short viewport overflows by 140px.
findings.suggestedFix: Use normal flow or anchored/top-layer positioning with explicit fallback positions and intrinsic inline sizing.

findings.summary: Recommendation and tracking behavior is not transparent or user-controlled
findings.evidence: Taboola/Criteo initialize on load and inject sensational recommendation content without a visible consent/preferences surface in tested states.
findings.suggestedFix: Default to no recommendation tracking, clearly label paid content, expose understandable privacy choices, and make refusal as easy as acceptance.

findings.summary: The logo wastes image bytes
findings.evidence: A 1692×2358 PNG transfers ~106KB for a 65×90 rendering; Lighthouse estimates ~106KB savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Export a correctly sized modern-format image and supply intrinsic dimensions/density variants.

findings.summary: Background advertising work dominates a tiny page
findings.evidence: A minimal shell triggers 41 requests and Lighthouse finds large unused JS/CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not initialize recommendations until requested or visible; remove unused dependencies and pause nonessential background work.

findings.summary: Third-party bytes are disproportionate
findings.evidence: Third parties account for 411KB across 35 requests, over half the transfer.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a strict third-party budget, remove Criteo/Taboola from initial load, and defer any retained integration behind user value.

taskList.title: Remove or explicitly gate the advertising/tracking stack
Restore semantic, labelled and visibly focusable search UI
Fix narrow/short viewport reflow with intrinsic sizing
Cut render-blocking resources and optimize/cache the logo
Publish real navigation, metadata, canonical and sitemap signals
Replace the storage-provider 404 with product recovery
